data.name: Nikodema
data.gender_notes: Nikodema is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew name 'Nikodemos' meaning 'victory of the people' or 'people's victory' in Greek, Nikodema is a name of biblical and saintly significance in Christianity. This name was borne by a Pharisee who played a key role in the crucifixion and later burial of Jesus. The name Nikodema carries the meaning “Victory of the people” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Nikodema usually hope their child will grow to embody victory of the people and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the victory of faith and spirituality over adversity and darkness.
data.etymology: Nikodema belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victory of the people.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nikodema total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_greek.name: Νικόδημος
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Νικόδημος είναι ο πρώτος από τους δώδεκα απεσταλμένους του Ιησού Χριστού, από την synagogue της Ιερουσαλήμ. Η λέξη Νικόδημος σημαίνει νικοτοσ μετης, που σημαίνει νθκτεριτεράσ, δηλαδή λεπτώς τεριςσ. Ο Νικόδημος παίζει σημαντικό ρόλο στην Καινή Διαθήκη, ιδιαίτερα σε διάφορα κείμενα του Ευαγγελίου του Ιωάννη.

in_latin.name: Nikodema
in_latin.long_meaning: Nikodema, nomine Graeco, significat primus synagogae, primus apostolus, qui a Iesu Christo missus est. In Veteri Testamento, Nikodema est unus ex duodecim apostolis, qui a Iesu Christo missi sunt. Etiam in Novo Testamento, Nikodema est unus ex discipulis Iesu Christi, qui eum sequuntur.

In the New Testament, Nikodema is one of the twelve apostles sent by Jesus Christ. He is also one of the disciples of Jesus Christ, who follow him. The name Nikodema is of Greek origin, and it means first of synagogue. It is a significant name in Christian tradition, and it is associated with the apostles of Jesus Christ. The name Nikodema is also used in modern times, and it is a popular name among Christians.

data.cultural_impact: Nikodema is a name deeply rooted in Christian history and tradition, evoking images of faith, devotion, and sacrifice. The character Nikodemos is mentioned in the New Testament in the Gospel of John, where he is portrayed as a Pharisee who believed in Jesus, and played a crucial role in securing the resources and support necessary for the burial of Jesus after His crucifixion. His actions demonstrated the importance of belief, respect, and compassion during a time of great turmoil and uncertainty.
data.spiritual_significance: The significance of the name Nikodema extends beyond its historical roots. It is the reminder of a man who, despite being a member of a strict religious sect, could put aside their differences and obey God's will in a tangible way. This serves as an exemplar for believers today, highlighting the importance of showing love, compassion, and kindness to all, including those from opposing religions or beliefs. Moreover, the name embodies the spirit of victory over adversity and the pursuit of truth, inspiring those who bear it to carry on the legacy of Nikodemos and share God's love with all they meet.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Nikodemas, meaning "victory of God," symbolizes the triumph of divine grace over human weakness and sin. This name encourages faith and trust in God's power to transform and renew.
